title: Core Pipelines Module
summary: This module provides foundational and specialized pipeline classes for common NLP and multimodal tasks, including automatic speech recognition, document question answering, and image-text-to-text generation. It leverages a chunking mechanism for efficient processing of large inputs.

nodes.label: Audio Input
nodes.title: Audio Input Source
nodes.description: Raw audio data or audio file paths provided by the user for transcription.

nodes.label: Document Image Input
nodes.title: Document Image Source
nodes.description: Document images and optional pre-extracted text/bounding boxes for question answering.

nodes.label: Image & Text Input
nodes.title: Multimodal Image/Text Input
nodes.description: Combined image and text data, potentially in conversational formats, for text generation.

nodes.label: Manage Chunked Data Processing
nodes.title: ChunkPipeline Base
nodes.description: A base class providing core logic for pipelines that process large inputs in manageable chunks, optimizing memory and performance.

nodes.label: Transcribe Speech
nodes.title: AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline
nodes.description: Orchestrates the process of converting audio input into transcribed text, handling various audio formats and model types (e.g., Whisper, CTC).

nodes.label: Answer Questions from Documents
nodes.title: DocumentQuestionAnsweringPipeline
nodes.description: Manages the workflow for answering questions based on visual documents, integrating OCR and model inference for LayoutLM-like or VisionEncoderDecoder models.

nodes.label: Generate Text from Images & Text
nodes.title: ImageTextToTextPipeline
nodes.description: Facilitates text generation from combined image and text inputs, supporting conversational and multimodal models.

nodes.label: Pretrained Model
nodes.title: Pretrained Model
nodes.description: A generic representation of a machine learning model used by the pipelines for inference across various tasks.

nodes.label: Feature Extractor
nodes.title: Feature Extractor
nodes.description: Component responsible for preparing raw input data (e.g., audio, image) into model-compatible features.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: Tokenizer
nodes.description: Component for converting text into numerical tokens for model input and decoding model outputs.

nodes.label: Multimodal Processor
nodes.title: Processor (Image/Text)
nodes.description: A unified component for handling both image and text preprocessing for multimodal models.

nodes.label: External Language Model (pyctcdecode)
nodes.title: pyctcdecode BeamSearchDecoderCTC
nodes.description: An external library used for boosting CTC decoding with a language model for improved transcription accuracy.

nodes.label: OCR Engine (Tesseract)
nodes.title: Tesseract OCR Engine
nodes.description: An external tool used to extract text and bounding boxes from images when not provided explicitly.

nodes.label: Transcribed Text Output
nodes.title: Transcribed Text Output
nodes.description: The resulting text transcription from audio processing by the ASR pipeline.

nodes.label: Document QA Answer Output
nodes.title: Document QA Answer Output
nodes.description: The extracted answer to a question from a document, including score and location.

nodes.label: Generated Text Output
nodes.title: Generated Text Output
nodes.description: The text generated by the multimodal model based on image and text inputs.

groups.label: Surface Pipelines
groups.title: User-Facing Pipeline Implementations
groups.description: These are the concrete pipeline implementations that users interact with for specific tasks.

groups.label: Core Pipeline Abstractions
groups.title: Foundational Pipeline Logic
groups.description: Base classes and abstract components that provide common functionality and structure for specialized pipelines.

groups.label: Input Sources
groups.title: External Data Inputs
groups.description: Various types of external data that serve as input to the pipelines.

groups.label: Output Destinations
groups.title: Pipeline Outputs
groups.description: The results produced by the execution of the pipelines.

groups.label: Data Processing & Model Components
groups.title: Shared Data & Model Components
groups.description: Components from other modules within the Transformers library that are utilized by these pipelines for data preparation and model inference.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: Third-Party Tool Integrations
groups.description: External libraries or tools integrated into the pipelines for specialized functionalities like language model boosting or OCR.
